title: Standard Vector Search index remains pending endpoint provisioning after endpoint is ONLINE
description: Please investigate Vector Search provisioning in our Premium SERVERLESS Azure Databricks workspace intellify-healthcare-dbw, East US. This is an isolated POC with three constant nonpatient documents and precomputed 768-dimensional vectors, no embedding model calls or healthcare source data. First endpoint hcp-foundation-search (UID 99251605-0190-424f-b04d-4a74ae7f9965) became ONLINE, but a four-minute index-readiness timeout was too short; it was deleted. We funded a separate retry: endpoint hcp-foundation-search-retry (UID 6d97cf32-701d-4b94-9c18-5e182a55650b) became ONLINE at 2026-10-27T13:48:16.902521Z. Direct-access index hc_test._foundation_probe.hcp_foundation_search remained not ready with indexed_row_count zero and message 'Direct access index creation is pending endpoint provisioning.' Upserts were rejected as initializing. The second attempt ran from 2026-10-27T13:48:13.783820Z to 2026-10-27T14:08:35.181244Z, including cleanup; its readiness allowance was twenty minutes inside a thirty-minute total probe contract. Both indexes and endpoints were confirmed deleted. Python SDK 0.157.0 and Databricks CLI 1.22.1. Please check the backend provisioning history, workspace entitlement/region/quota/network dependencies, whether a longer readiness allowance is required, and a supported corrective action before another paid lifecycle. We have not classified the feature as unsupported and have not created a third endpoint. No production workload is affected. Please do not recreate or expand billable resources without our approval.
